design_status: approved room-to-room concept; exact layout provisional until playtested
coordinate_system: zero-based per-room (x,y), top-left origin, x right, y down

D.label: room_doorway
D.effect_v02: trigger linked room transition on player entering tile

F.label: front_entrance
F.effect_v02: hazmat spawn; no player room transition

X.label: rear_exit
X.effect_v02: Stage 1 complete on Billy entering tile

dining.label: Dining Room
dining.challenge: open maneuvering, tables, booths, hazmat introduction

kitchen.label: Kitchen / Service
kitchen.challenge: tighter lanes, fixed fryers and prep tables; grease inert in v0.2

storage.label: Storage / Back Exit
storage.challenge: shelving/slalom and final escape; no added hazmat in v0.2

gameplay_v02.input: one joystick cardinal step per movement tick; Fire NOT used for a gas attack yet; cutscene Fire unchanged
gameplay_v02.player_collision: solid tiles and map bounds block; D and X are walkable triggers; one axis per tick
gameplay_v02.movement: tile steps acceptable; preserve responsive cadence from v0.1 if practical
gameplay_v02.hazmat: One initial hazmat pursuer, activated at 180 NTSC frames (~3 seconds); cardinal walkable pursuit within its room. Preserve the same entity across room transitions; it must not vanish or duplicate.
gameplay_v02.hazmat_room_follow: When Billy crosses a linked doorway with the pursuer in the old room, keep the pursuer state and queue a chase through the same doorway 90 NTSC frames (~1.5s) later. Enter through the adjacent room's inward spawn (x=1 or x=38, same doorway y), finding a neighboring walkable unoccupied tile if required. If Billy backtracks before this follow completes, cancel the pending follow and resume the preserved original-room pursuer. A pursuer in an intermediate room must follow subsequent linked rooms sequentially, never teleport across nonadjacent rooms. Do not respawn from the initial spawn on room load.
gameplay_v02.optional_future_hazmat: Side kitchen and storage markers remain disabled in this prototype.
gameplay_v02.restart: Caught -> show CAUGHT and allow START stage-only reset (room dining, Billy and one pursuer reset); no life deduction yet.
gameplay_v02.backtrack: Player may reverse through the same D doorway; do not reset fixed room layout or pursuer state.
gameplay_v02.exit: Billy entering X in storage displays STAGE COMPLETE, silent placeholder; do not launch Road 1 yet.
